title: Milk & Mix - My First AI Game
author: nasipoutine
selftext:
I was honestly anxious about sharing this, but my first game, Milk & Mix, now has a playable alpha! It’s a cozy boba making game where you mix drinks for animal and human customers.

I’ve always loved making games but struggled with some technical obstacles. I used ChatGPT Astra to help build the game, and Meshy for the 3D assets. One ongoing challenge has been getting the pouring to feel responsive while keeping things running smoothly on mobile.

I’m still developing it and would love some feedback.
